**Date:** February 20, 2025

**Subject:** Outstanding invoices and payment reminder

Dear Mr. de Vries,

I am writing to follow up on two outstanding invoices for services rendered by Benelux Logistics Group to NordTech Solutions over the past quarter.

The first invoice (INV-2024-0742) dated October 15, 2024 for **EUR 12.850,00** was due on November 14, 2024 and remains unpaid as of today. This invoice has been outstanding for over 90 days. As per our general terms and conditions (section 8.3), a late payment penalty of 1.5% per month applies, bringing the current amount owed to **EUR 13.429,38** including accumulated interest.

The second invoice (INV-2024-1105) dated January 10, 2025 for **EUR 7.200,00** is due on February 28, 2025. We kindly ask you to ensure timely payment of this invoice.

Please find both invoices and a formal payment reminder attached below.

We would appreciate your prompt attention to this matter. If you have any questions or wish to discuss a payment arrangement, please do not hesitate to contact me directly.

Kind regards,
Sophie Verhoeven
